thesis: The episode explores how the OTC derivatives market evolved from informal Telegram chats to sophisticated, electronified RFQ systems connecting institutional clients with major market makers. It introduces Variational's mission to bring this trillion-dollar OTC market on-chain by disaggregating settlement, margining, and derivative payoff logic into programmable primitives to support the Omni Perp Dex.
